summary: Frontend-only smoke test of ParaTech (parachute technical management app). Home loads with 3 seed rows (Mirage G4, Sigma, Vector), search filters instantly, type/status filters work, detail page shows 4 clickable cards. Voile principale sheet shows total (1 250) and depuis-cone (250); +1 saut correctly increments BOTH to 1 251/251 (toast 'Saut ajouté (+1 total, +1 cône)' visible). Cone change dialog opens with date picker + observation, on save the depuis-cone counter resets to 0 while total stays at 1 251. New reserve pack computes validity date +12 months (year 2027 verified in body). Maintenance sheet opens. Header +Ajouter navigates to /nouveau with correct form (Type BOI, Référence, N° série). Print button present. No forbidden words (bénéficiaire/utilisateur/perception) found anywhere.
passed: Home loads with 3 seed parachutes in horizontal rectangles with 4 sections
Instant search 'VP-72031' filters to exactly 1 row
Filter by type BOI reduces list to 2 rows
Clicking a row opens detail with card-sac/card-voile-principale/card-voile-secours/card-appareil-securite
Voile principale sheet shows total 1 250 and depuis-cone 250 (visually confirmed in screenshot)
btn-add-jump increments both counters to 1 251 / 251 (toast confirms +1 total, +1 cône)
btn-cone-change opens dialog with date picker + observation; after save depuis-cone resets to 0 while total unchanged (1 251)
btn-new-pack computes validity = pack date + 12 months (year 2027 visible)
add-parachute-button navigates to /nouveau form with Type/Référence/N° série
No forbidden person-related words (bénéficiaire, utilisateur, perception) present
notes: Deeper flows not exercised in this smoke pass: JSON export/import, Settings persistence & applying new 6-month validity, Réparation status change, Archive/désarchive round-trip, Maintenance & Réparation tabs page, Print A4 layout content, edit-jumps manual dialog. Recommended to be covered in full testing pass.
